arguments.content: Mandatory acknowledgement fields can regress independently shipped clients after successful writes. In enhanced-settings task 1, staged client.py requires applied=True on all saves, including enhanced_settings=False. The actual supported provider at eval-release (22140737b2bc5792b535f3f8ce16f7fa162101db, provider/settings.py) persists values and returns only {ok: True}; the HEAD client (ac09e55463b2d33bba4cdf6a759d759e3d80c024) reports success, whereas the staged client raises after the same durable write. P1, reproduced with actual historical provider source. A stub updated to include the new acknowledgement keeps the unit test green while hiding the incompatibility. Verify persisted state and caller-visible outcome against the named supported provider, and retain its legacy success contract until receipt capability is established. A disabled UI flag does not gate unconditional protocol changes.
